product.name: 1105 Series Round-End Pattern Plate (2 Hole, 56mm Length)

warnings: Length (56), width (32) and thickness (2.5) are the listed dimensions, and the ends are full semicircles of radius 16. The 14mm hole diameter is listed. The ±12mm spacing of the two large holes is estimated from the images, which also show them centered on the width axis and concentric with the rounded ends. The smaller pattern holes (about 14 visible, some slotted) follow the listed 16mm goBILDA pattern. Their 4mm diameter is assumed from that standard and not stated here, and their positions are left empty because the images give no printed coordinates.
Small hole positions are estimated from the image, not from the goBILDA drawing; the 14-hole layout is approximate.
Small hole diameter of 4 mm is assumed from the goBILDA standard.
Slotted holes (slotted to 24mm across center) are modeled as round holes because slot extents are uncertain.
Big hole spacing of ±12 mm is assumed concentric with the end radii.
The first line of the code assigns an unused alias for math, which is harmless.
